thread:
sam: quick async standup — SDKs / quickstarts / sample apps. Short updates: Origami sample packaging landed on the CI branch but docs still out-of-date. sharing checklist below.

alyssa: nice! did a smoke run of the origami sample on linux container, found a path issue in README (relative path for assets). will open a tiny PR. :+1:

maria: blocker — the notebook quickstart still expects the old config env var REDWOOD_API_KEY instead of REDWOOD_INFERENCE_KEY. i can patch but want to confirm we want the new name for public docs?

sam: yes use REDWOOD_INFERENCE_KEY for all new docs. add a short compatibility note in the quickstart: "if using older creds, map REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_INFERENCE_KEY"

jon: code-review ping for origami sample PR 42. left two comments: one on readme wording, one on test fixture teardown. ping me when addressed, i'll do a final pass.

tim: FYI, CI flake on mac-latest for the wheel build — failing to find cytoolz binary. i'm reproducing locally on M1. swapping to a lighter build matrix for the quickstart package until we pin wheels.

becca: i'll take the docs side: will update the quickstart step-by-step + add the env var note. planning a tiny screenshot refresh too. aiming for a PR today.

sam: summary of actions:
- alyssa -> docs PR for README path fix (small)
- becca -> quickstart doc update + screenshot + env var note
- jon -> review PR 42 after alyssa addresses comments
- tim -> temp CI tweak to avoid M1 flake, follow-up on wheel pinning
- maria -> patch notebook quickstart once env var name confirmed

devex-bot: deployed preview site for origami-sample at https://deploy-preview-421--origami-docs.netlify.app (build log: https://ci.redwood.ai/logs/421) :rocket:

maria: thanks. i'll re-run notebook tests against the preview site and update test matrix.

alyssa: opened PR 43 for README path fix, small diff. linking here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/origami-sample/pull/43

jon: reviewing now, minor nit on wording. will approve after alyssa updates.

sam: one more note — can we add a one-liner in the SDK changelog about the quickstart rename so users searching for REDWOOD_API_KEY find context? becca, could you add that in your PR?

becca: yep will add changelog line and a short migration snippet.

tim: i've pushed a temporary CI change to skip mac wheel build for the quickstart job: https://ci.redwood.ai/changes/2987 — will revert once wheels pinned.

sam: awesome. tonight i'll run the final smoke once PRs are merged, then mark the quickstart as ship-ready. thanks all :clap:

jon: thanks team, moving to review queue.

devex-bot: reminder: docs-review rotation assigned to @jon and @becca this week.

sam: end of check-in. if anything urgent reply here, otherwise i'll close the thread after final smoke.
